families.name: Q norm → 动态量化 → Q 投影，多算子链
families.composed_opportunity: RMS→exact rounded norm output→row quantization→Q projection can share reads,scale production and tile handoff.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: F05/F06/F07/F09 overlap the same input/norm/quant/projection surfaces;count each once. A shared quantized input is conditional on the exact PreparedLinearInput/quantizer contract.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Retain BF16 norm rounding before quantization,original full-row reduction and all norm consumers. Scaling before rounding or canceling RMS against a downstream linear map is not automatically equivalent.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Keep necessary norm/quant work plus classical projection MACs;max(Cube,Vector,necessary traffic) with shared capacity,not the sum of standalone limits.

families.name: Q 与 KV 投影，共享输入或合并投影
families.composed_opportunity: Joint Q/KV/input preparation may reuse an identical source scan or jointly tile compatible projections.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: Same input does not merge distinct weights/MACs. Combining with F17/F33 may introduce mixed FLOAT/BF16 kernels,new output packing and different communication demands.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Match row ownership,value/weight generations,dtypes and output rounding. Retain any earlier KV/cache or coefficient deadline;price replicated weights and producer-before-collective alternatives.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Sum only distinct necessary MACs within one mode/pool;keep mode-specific maxima until an issue-sharing proof exists. Derive necessary input/weight bytes from residency and chosen algorithm.

families.name: Q 投影 → RoPE，生产者与消费者组合
families.composed_opportunity: Q projection output can feed tail RoPE directly in a tile-preserving producer epilogue.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: This consumes the same projection/rope intermediate also used by Q/KV/index variants. Legacy CP head-RMS afterQB is outside the frozen V41 query path and remains a separate reference.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Keep the original BF16 projection output rounding,positions,head partition,rotated tail and unchanged dimensions. An on-chip interface still honors all other readers and original capture/output banks.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Only an otherwise materialized interface is a candidate byte budget;not all HBM traffic. Tile pipeline readiness may be finer than whole-operator completion.

families.name: KV 投影 → norm → RoPE → SWA 缓存写入
families.composed_opportunity: KV projection→norm→RoPE→SWA store can become one public producer,or current query consumers can use an exact bypass while future cache publication is retained.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: Direct-store fusion and delayed/COW/shadow/recompute publication are alternative graphs. F11/F19/F27/F29/F34 share cache planes and must not double-count stores or observer demand.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Current verify can need newly produced KV before acceptance. Keep page/slot/position/owner generations,all current/future readers and queued writers;prefix acceptance count is not token identity.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Compare nonduplicate transform work and necessary persistent writes for the chosen initial state. Shadow/COW/recompute pays its own reads,writes,extra work and live memory.

families.name: Index query 投影 → RoPE → 量化
families.composed_opportunity: Indexer query projection→tailRoPE→per-head quantization can share exact qR input preparation or a tile handoff.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: Reuse of Q/index quantized input is distinct from sharing projection weights or deleting query-specific quantization. Weight/RoPE overlap already present in the baseline earns no new credit.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Retain BF16 RoPE boundary,FP16 scale rounding,minimum2^-24,div_rn and nearbyint source rules. Separate original qR/parameter/row epochs and all future readers.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Typed BF16/INT8 work and Vector conversion/quantization remain. SplitK or upstream panel representation has its own reductions,publication and numeric cost.

families.name: Index weight 投影 → 转换与缩放
families.composed_opportunity: Weight projection→BF16→FP32 scale→FP16 product may fuse conversion/scaling into the same typed producer.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: F09/F10/F12 compete for auxiliary stream/Vector/Cube capacity. One early/late stream interval is not guaranteed overlap or extra hardware.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Preserve every intermediate round and original reduction ordering;head-weight values/scales must match the query quantizer generation. A mathematically combined real product is not IEEE equivalence.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Use mode-specific necessary work and required interfaces after transformation;keep native FLOAT/HF32 modes and cache traffic conditional.

families.name: Index key norm → RoPE → 量化 → key/scale 缓存写入
families.composed_opportunity: Index key norm→RoPE→quantization→key/scale cache store can fuse under one persistent-output contract.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: The compressor latent fork F19 and SWA/shared KV F08/F33 may share a source but not automatically gamma,quantizer,scale dtype or cache layout.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Retain key/scale pair coherence,original quantizer precision,valid rows,slots,causal positions and all query generations. A shared pointer is not equality of key content/epoch.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Count both required typed key and scale outputs;selected cache residency and persistent observation determine traffic floors,not the whole cache allocation.

families.name: Indexer TopK → 索引修整 → 共享索引发布；候选块号排序跨层复用或位图 mask
families.composed_opportunity: Score/TopK→visibility/chronological repair→index publication can share passes;one produced C1 candidate map can serve its exact four consumers with a list or bitmap representation.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: C1 candidate-producer/consumer and C2 full-scan modes differ. Membership penalties can leave finite-score fillers outside the allowed set;list/bitmap,early pruning,localTopK merge and certified speculative tiles are alternative contracts.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Preserve comparator,ties,NaNs/finite-sentinel behavior,valid multiplicity,chronological order,-1 tail and all map/position/forward epochs. A changed query forbids blanket cross-layer/iteration result reuse.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Keep required score/selection work unless a complete demand certificate permits pruning. New bitmap construction,merge,summary certification,publication and fallback/reread work are paid once.

families.name: 稀疏注意力复合边界
families.composed_opportunity: Already-fused sparse attention has opportunities at input/cache/index/output interfaces and in a legally ordered SWA-before-index/CSA continuation.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: Splitting SWA/CSA and later joining online state is an alternative to the existing fused kernel. Duplicate KV elimination,projected state or rounded summaries each require their own exact domain.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Preserve selected sparse edges,sink exactly once,BF16 exponent/PV and accumulation order,all original masks/visibility/page generations. Real-arithmetic softmax state merge alone does not prove floating point equivalence.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Necessary work depends on actual sparse edges and allowed algorithm. Independent Cube/Vector/cache/network lower bounds combine by max;no new internal-fusion or fullN² work credit.

families.name: Attention → 逆 RoPE → 布局恢复 → 输出投影
families.composed_opportunity: Attention→inverse tailRoPE→layout/head restoration→output projection can share tile materialization or move a projection across communication under new ownership.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: F14/F15/F16 describe overlapping interfaces. WA-before-AlltoAll,full-group weight replication,query-owner projection and current group-specialized paths are mutually competing schedules.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Preserve rotated64-tail/unchanged448-dim source domain,all BF16 boundaries,head/group permutation and original sum order. Keep partial-output readers and the exact collective membership/protocol.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Price changed per-rank MACs,all necessary weight replicas,padding and card ingress jointly. Fewer interface bytes is not a latency prediction.

families.name: Attention 输出填充/恢复 → 投影
families.composed_opportunity: Padding/restoration and projection can use a virtual-valid-row representation or a final direct producer instead of a separate copy/pad.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: Current compact G1 and larger all-group output paths are distinct. A late row-demand cut may require max(U_p) padding rather than ceil(totalU/TP).
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Retain bias and zero/nonfinite semantics,logical/physical extents and every consumer. Zero padding is not automatically zero projection when nonfinite weights or observed tails matter.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Only required outputs/rows can be removed;changed padding/tile utilization,ownership and metadata costs remain in the same work/traffic ledger.

families.name: 两级输出投影与 reduce-scatter 的分块重组
families.composed_opportunity: Two output projections and reduce-scatter may pipeline tiles while retaining the original intermediate numeric surface,or use a separately justified repartition.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: A precomposed WA*WB matrix or one unrounded accumulator is a new numeric domain. RawINT32 reduction,post-dequant BF16 reduction and selected-owner schedules are alternatives.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Preserve intermediate BF16 round,dequant/scale order,full dot products,collective sum/tie/protocol and owner-visible outputs. Do not commute a reduction across nonlinear quantization by real linear algebra alone.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Keep distinct necessary per-mode projection work and derive the new payload cut. Shared Cube/Vector/communication budgets and changed weight memory prevent adding ideal speedups.

families.name: Compressor 两路输入投影，共享转换或分块
families.composed_opportunity: Two compressor input projections may share exact source conversions or be jointly tiled,including the SWA/C2 mixed projection frontier.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: C1/BF16 and C2/FLOAT branches are not a single BF16 GEMM by default. F06/F33/projection-before-gather change weight replication,packing and input availability.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Preserve FLOAT/HF32 and BF16 rounding domains and both consumers. BF16-representable input does not prove FLOAT weights/results reducible to BF16;segmented/mixed representations have explicit bridges.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Mode-wise MAC/cycle cases remain separate;extra conversion/dequant/packing/readiness and cold/warm weight traffic are included. No automatic savings of one of two different matrices.

families.name: Compressor 状态池化 → norm
families.composed_opportunity: Compressor state pooling/gating→norm may combine a state-aware kernel or operate incrementally on the exact changed ring window.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: F18/F19/F34 overlap ring/latent/cache state. Full pooling,incremental update,recompute and output memoization are alternative schedules and storage choices.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Keep ring tuple/half/slot/position/generation,old-state reads before writes,gate/softmax/norm rounds and wraparound/partial-window behavior. A stable ring pointer or append count is not content identity.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Necessary state work depends on the selected algorithm and proven unchanged region. Pay retained or new state,publication,recompute and live capacity once.

families.name: Compressor latent 分叉 → index key 与压缩 KV
families.composed_opportunity: A compressor latent can fork to index-key and compressed-KV consumers with a shared exact producer or shared norm/transform when value contracts match.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: Do not conflate shared latent input with identical gamma/rotation/quantization or output banks. Source ownership,context/KV publication and index consumers overlap F08/F11/F18/F27/F29/F33/F34.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Retain every consumer and persistent key/scale/KV generation;cross-layer/iteration reuse requires actual value/parameter/position equality. Changed field aliases or publication order need their own contract.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Count common necessary work once only when identity is proved;keep separate typed branch work,required stores and extended lifetime otherwise.

families.name: C1 compressor 与 SWA KV 的同域投影共享、联合分块与前移通信
families.composed_opportunity: C1 compressor/SWA same-domain projections may share a producer or use projection-before-communication with a consistent new row and weight ownership.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: Combine with F06/F08/F17/F19 using one selected representation. Existing HC local collapse and compact baseline paths are not new savings;C2FLOAT remains its own mode.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Match source rows/weights/config generations,all rounding and valid/padded dimensions. New projected payload or group placement must supply every original consumer and bank epoch.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Re-derive joint required raw/projected information and card ingress;price weight replicas,extra arithmetic/packing,finite Vector/Cube and old/new live buffers. Do not add overlapping input-byte budgets.

families.name: 响应等待路径的轮询开销与重复等待工作
families.composed_opportunity: Polling/wait completion can become an ordered event/notification or share a wait pipeline when outputs are actually ready.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: H01/H02/H05 share host submission/result boundaries. CPU delay can postpone peer arrivals inside a resident device kernel;it is not universally irrelevant to low device arithmetic activity.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Preserve cancellation/error/result ordering and producer-ready/consumer-retire semantics. Historical thread evidence is not a current171 onCPU cost or a causal wait-time fraction.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Host/controller work and queue capacity remain symbolic/current-unmeasured;do not subtract wall waits as CPU work or add an ideal host gain to the full device gain.

families.name: 输入准备中剩余小拷贝、锁页和元数据工作的合并重组
families.composed_opportunity: Snapshot-derived indices/counts/positions/masks and small pinned copies may share a final producer or transfer,including the exact CP-cache-hit dead-producer domain.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: H02/F20/F24/F31/F35/H06/H07 overlap the same banks. Merge submission is different from changing data representation,cache identity or eliminating a required copy.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Keep all field dtypes/strides/valid tails,source snapshot/alias rules,queued DMA ownership and per-stream/rank completion. Use actual CP cache-hit keys;no independent buffers from different names.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Count necessary per-field work and unique materialization once;source buffers live through DMA,consumer banks through old readers and new writers. No HBM/time bound from logical interface bytes alone.

families.name: 前缀块哈希的跨请求重复工作
families.composed_opportunity: Exact immutable token-prefix block-hash chains can be memoized/shared within the original namespace before suffix work.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: Current prefix caching with SHA256/block128 is already enabled. H03 avoids repeated hash work only;existing KV-cache hits are not new wins. H04 text-tokenization reuse is a different key domain.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Keep parent hash,token IDs,block boundaries,salt/adapter/model/config and all original namespace inputs. Same text prefix or buffer address alone is not a valid hash-result reuse key.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Compare repeated hash work with one certified prefix plus each suffix and cache/lookup overhead. It is host work,not repeated NPU model compute or fullKV traffic.

families.name: 前端长提示 tokenization 的精确复用、排队与批处理
families.composed_opportunity: Tokenization can batch work or exactly reuse an identical normalized prompt/tokenizer input;prefix reuse needs a certified tokenizer boundary/carry state.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: H04/H03 may share an immutable admitted-input object,but token IDs and text are not one interchangeable hash namespace. Partial text prefix reuse can fail at a token merge across the boundary.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Retain tokenizer revision/options,normalization/formatting,added tokens and exact IDs. Keep input length/error and request ownership semantics;do not infer identical tokenization from equal character count.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Use the actual host function/transduction work and current queue constraints. Saved function time alone is not a request critical-path gain or device-utilization improvement.

families.name: 前端 DecodeStream 早段长调用与输出就绪流水
families.composed_opportunity: Result-ready transport,decode/serialization and notifications may pipeline or batch under an explicit unchanged response contract.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: H05/H01/H02 share staging/events and H06/speculative acceptance controls result sizes. First nonempty client text is a response boundary,not a device prefill completion timestamp.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Keep request/token order,accepted-prefix contents,logprob/usage/finish/error fields and feedback readiness. Changing chunk granularity/timing is a different contract;no premature publication of a partially ready ID bank.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Current causal ready/onCPU/transport costs stay unmeasured where absent. A long main-thread wall interval is not entirely removable CPU work;no free overlap or duplicate ideal gain.

families.name: 固定 speculative 宽度下的 padding 域拆分与图 bucket 重组
families.composed_opportunity: Uniform speculative width6 and TP8 give the existing minimum compatible24-token descriptor;logical/physical row-domain splitting can define a new packing/bucket ABI.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: Drop-in16 is excluded in that unchanged uniform-width/TP domain. Smaller logical counts,nonuniform/segmented packing,multiple descriptors or row-owner shifts are alternative implementations,not one shape edit.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Retain request boundaries,valid masks,global/local counts,slots,all target/draft metadata,peer collective agreement and captured bank lifetime. Every affected kernel/consumer must understand the new logical versus physical domain.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Reprice padding work,extra packing/launches,per-card maximum owner demand and receiver expert work jointly. Fewer allocated rows need not reduce the bottleneck cut or full MoE receiver demand.

families.name: 原始 token ID 图回放与图外 embedding 的单一生产路径
families.composed_opportunity: Raw-token graph input and graph-external embedding can become one selected authoritative production path when duplicate values/consumers are proved.
families.mutual_overlap_and_alternative_graphs: H07/H02/H06/F02/F24/F31 overlap raw-ID,embedding,graph-bank and Engram readers. Existing64replay associations are provenance,not independent field-deadness proof.
families.semantic_numerical_ownership_and_state_c: Preserve all raw-ID/embedding users,parameter/row/layout epochs,capture addresses and optional renorm or weight mutations. max_norm/renorm needs its original observable effect or an independent idempotence certificate.
families.necessary_work_and_joint_limit_route: Count one exact duplicate producer only after all reads/writes are reconciled;no automatic embedding-table HBM credit. Bank live memory and producer/collective readiness remain priced.
